description: Deterministic fuse-bead pattern quantization, AI matrix-to-pattern compilation, stray-bead despeckling, perceptual color matching (CIEDE2000), and SVG construction-sheet rendering.
author: zwhy149

tools.name: create_pixel_pattern
tools.description: Compile an ASCII/character pixel matrix or 2D token grid plus optional colorMap into a validated MARD-compatible bead pattern JSON, crafting complexity summary, and optional SVG sheet.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Array of equal-length row strings (e.g. ["..RR..", ".RRRR."]) or 2D array of color tokens. Use "." or " " for empty cells.

parameters.name: colorMap
parameters.description: Map of matrix character/token -> MARD code (e.g. "F5") or CSS HEX (e.g. "#E7002F").

parameters.name: includeSvg
parameters.description: When true, returns a rendered SVG construction sheet string.

tools.name: generate_pattern
tools.description: Convert a local PNG image file into a MARD-compatible 221-code fuse-bead pattern with optional stray-bead despeckling and SVG construction sheet.

parameters.name: imagePath
parameters.description: Path to an existing PNG file on disk.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Target grid rows (4-160). Defaults to width.

parameters.name: processMode
parameters.description: Quantization mode: cartoon | detail | document | photo | pixel. Default: cartoon.

parameters.name: despeckle
parameters.description: Clean isolated 1-bead noise after quantization. Default: true.

parameters.name: includeSvg
parameters.description: Include rendered SVG construction sheet. Default: false.

tools.name: optimize_pattern
tools.description: Optimize an existing bead-grid-studio pattern JSON: clean isolated stray beads, optionally merge rare colors (<=2 beads), and compute build complexity metrics.

parameters.name: mergeRareColors
parameters.description: Auto-merge <=2-bead rare colors with deltaE <= 18 into closest used neighbor. Default: false.

tools.name: lookup_palette
tools.description: Search the MARD-compatible 221 bead palette by CSS HEX color (perceptual CIEDE2000), exact code, or color series (A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/M).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB), MARD code (e.g. "H7"), or series letter ("A"-"M").
